author: OriginalFrenchy
body:
Minecraft Username : OriginalFrenchy 
Reason: I was banned because of ban evasion, and Ik this is a serious matter but I can explain. My friend and I [IAm_Enrico] share an alt account. My friend got banned, and I was on the alt account at the time because we donate to servers on that account so we can play together and I logged on to avicus. This resulted in me being banned for ban evasion, as my friend played on that account, while he was banned. Fair enough. I moved on to my main, as I wanted to play and this resulted in me being banned again for ban evasion, I understand that confusion and I get it's hard to believe but this is what happened. Now I can't play on avicus anymore and I'm really disapointed, I apologise for this but I would like to play again.

Sorry, OriginalFrenchy.

A couple of things don't really add up. Why would you be on IAm_Enrico's alt if you know your friend has been banned and that you could be caught ban evading? And why did you come exactly straight after i banned mrpiggyfin111 on your main if you know you just got banned on your friends alt?
